text: Entry Requirements （1）Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passport (applicants for undergraduate degrees are advised to have the passports with at least 4-year validity), and a no criminal record; （2）Good health condition and virtuous morality. Comply with Chinese Laws, regulations and rules of XUT; （3）Applicants normally should be 18 to 25 years old. （4）Excellent senior middle school graduates or those with equivalent degrees;
